historical_bracket: 12th Century CE (Chalukya Court of Somesvara III)

critical_structural_nodes.martial_leaping_poses: Dardurasana (Leaping frog pose executed via Paravrtta Jangha)
critical_structural_nodes.clandestine_pharmakon_arts: Candali-Bija alchemical invisibility grid (Sodrsyo jayate narah)

thesis_verification: Somesvara III explicitly codifies advanced contortionist splits (sucika) and pole apparatus athletics (stambhakridanika) under courtly theatrical science, while Buddhist commentaries categorize these identical physical skills as the low-caste street performance trades of Langhakas and Kumbhathunikas.
